$comment: THE cross-language field contract for the §8.3 push route. Both sides read THIS file - Go embeds it (contract.go), TypeScript imports it (frontend/src/lib/field-contract.ts). Same pattern as backend/seed/{digest,normalization}-vectors.json: one artefact, two consumers, so the two implementations cannot drift. Editing a cap or an allowlist entry here changes server enforcement AND the input that feeds it, in one commit. max_ops_per_push is the §8.3 per-request op cap the client chunks its drain to.
$comment_max_items_per_list: The per-list row cap [D-217]: a push create that would add a NEW items row to a list already holding this many rows - living, checked and tombstoned alike, since every one of them is storage - is denied `list_full`. A merge or a restore adds no row and is never refused. The bound on what one member can make the server store, which the per-IP rate limits only slow down. This is the default: SHOPPINGLIST_MAX_ITEMS_PER_LIST moves it (internal/listcap), and where it is set below max_items an import may bring only that many items - the server stamps the cap into the shell document so the client checks a file against the same number (frontend/src/lib/config.ts).

backup.$comment: The [D-72] per-list backup envelope, shared for the same reason as everything else in this file: the exporter (frontend backup.ts) and the importer (internal/lists/import.go) must agree on format, version and caps, and each side's tests assert against this one copy, so a one-sided edit cannot pass both suites and fail only on a real user's file.

$comment_server_stamped: Columns the server stamps and no op may carry: none is writable (contract_test.go), and the client's stamp companions, the optimistic values an op keeps beside the field that implies them, cover exactly this set (frontend/src/lib/sync/reasons-contract.test.ts).
$comment_push_statuses: The per-op `status` a §8.3 push result can carry. The Go pushStatus consts (internal/sync/types.go) and the client's PUSH_STATUSES (frontend/src/lib/sync/types.ts) are both pinned to this list.
$comment_list_limit: The refusal the three list-making routes (create, clone, import) share when an account is on as many lists as the server allows: this HTTP status, a body carrying this code, and the cap as `max`. internal/lists/populate.go answers it (its tests read it here) and frontend/src/lib/actions/lists.ts recognises it by these values.
$comment_demo_lifetime_hours: How long a demo account lives, counted from its creation: the demo build's sweep deletes by it (internal/demo) and the demo banner counts down to it (frontend/src/lib/demo/start.ts).
$comment_denied_reasons: The `denied` reason codes the §8.3 push route can return. The Go const block (internal/sync/types.go) and the client's DeniedReason union are both pinned to this list, so a code added on one side cannot be missing on the other.
$comment_palette: The twenty-one curated category color tokens [D-37]. frontend/src/lib/categories.ts, src/app.css and backend/seed/categories.json are pinned to this list, so a typo in the seed fails a test instead of rendering gray. The frontend maps tokens to light/dark-safe CSS values; an unknown token renders gray.
$comment_row_shape: The canonical client-facing row columns per collection (itemRecordMap / categoryRecordMap in internal/sync/types.go, normalizeItem / normalizeCategory in frontend/src/lib/sync/record.ts), all pinned to this list. The writable allowlist above covers only the subset a client may set.

accounts.$comment: NOT a push collection - accounts are never carried in a sync op. The cap lives here because `nickname` is the one accounts column a client writes (the §11 self-update allowlist, internal/account/guard.go), it is one of the two user-controlled strings this app publishes to OTHER people (the §7.4 roster serves it to every co-member; a list's name is the other, [D-08]), and the passkey signup route writes it with SaveNoValidate - so PocketBase's own text validation never runs there and this number is the enforcement. Sized like a display name, not a bio.

credentials.$comment: NOT a push collection. `friendly_name` is the passkey's device label, written by two routes (internal/account/rename_credential.go and internal/webauthn/handlers.go), which both read this cap. credentials.UpdateRule is nil (migration 1778000003), so those two routes are the only writers.

lists.$comment: NOT a push collection - lists are never carried in a sync op (processOp refuses any collection but items/list_categories). `name` is the list's one name, shared by its members ([D-08]). Three server routes write it with SaveNoValidate (list create, clone/import via populateList), which bypasses PocketBase's field validation, and members rename through lists.UpdateRule, where the lists package's update guard reads this same cap - so it is the bound on every path.
